content.title: FAG 6302-2RS Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 15x42x13mm, Rubber Sealed, Chrome Steel, ABEC-1
content.short_description: FAG 6302-2RS is a chrome steel deep groove ball bearing with rubber seals on both sides, bore 15 mm, OD 42 mm, width 13 mm, ABEC-1/P0 precision class.
content.long_description:
The FAG 6302-2RS is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized 15 mm bore x 42 mm outer diameter x 13 mm width. Rings and balls are made of chrome steel (GCr15/52100), a standard bearing steel used for rolling element applications requiring consistent hardness and dimensional stability.

The bearing carries a 2RS seal configuration, meaning both sides are fitted with rubber seals. This seal type is designed to retain internal lubricant and restrict entry of dust and debris in the operating environment.

Manufactured to ABEC-1/P0 precision class, this bearing meets standard tolerance requirements for general industrial rotating equipment applications where high-precision tolerances are not required.

Use the 6302-2RS designation and the 15x42x13mm dimensions to confirm fit against existing housing and shaft specifications before ordering.
bullets: Seal Type: 2RS, rubber sealed both sides
Bearing Type: Single-row deep groove ball bearing
